task_completion.description: Reconfigure SeisComP to enable PGV amplitude computation.

task_completion.description: Configure the system to use the specified MySQL database and SDS archive path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the database URI 'mysql://sysop:sysop@localhost/seiscomp' and the archive path 'sdsarchive:///home/ga/seiscomp/var/lib/archive' being entered into SeisComP settings or command arguments.

task_completion.description: Reprocess the Noto Peninsula earthquake event to generate new amplitudes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The VLM should see a processing window (e.g., scmag or scevent) or a terminal execution showing the reprocessing of the 2024-01-01 event data.

task_completion.description: Verify that PGV amplitudes were successfully calculated for the event.

task_completion.description: Create the final CSV report at the specified location with correct headers.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file manager or text editor showing a file at '~/Documents/pgv_report.csv' containing columns for 'Station' and 'Amplitude' with PGV values.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply type the CSV content from memory without running SeisComP.
integrity.visual_evidence: The VLM should see the agent interacting with SeisComP modules or database queries before the CSV file is generated.

integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show SeisComP windows (scconfig, scolv, or scart) or specific SeisComP CLI tools being invoked.

integrity.description: The data processed matches the 2024-01-01 Noto Peninsula earthquake.
